ei.title: Practice 02 — '보통'이고 싶은 욕구와 개성에 대한 갈망
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① are accepting → are accepted: 우리가 '받아들여지는' 대상이므로 수동태(are accepted).
det.analysis:
✅ ① are accepting(오류): 'we fit in and are accepting by others' — 우리는 다른 사람에 의해 '받아들여지는' 대상이므로 수동태 are accepted가 맞음. 'by others(다른 사람에 의해)'가 수동의 결정적 단서. 능동 are accepting은 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② recognized: 'being recognized as individuals' — 동명사 being 뒤 수동 과거분사. 정상

❌ ③ merely: 'not merely blend in' — 동사 blend를 꾸미는 부사. 정상

❌ ④ visible: 'We want to be visible' — be동사 뒤 보어 형용사. 정상
det.tip: be + p.p. + by ~ = 수동태. are accepted by others(다른 사람에게 받아들여지다). by가 보이면 수동을 의심하세요.

❌ ② ultimate(궁극적인): 괴짜의 궁극적 목표 — 적절

❌ ③ recognized(인정받는): 개인으로 인정받으려 애씀 — 적절

❌ ④ visible(보이는): 눈에 띄는 존재가 되고 싶어 함 — 적절
det.tip: avoid being regarded as 'difficult to deal with'(다루기 어려운 사람으로 여겨지기를 피하다). seek(추구)이면 글의 논리가 무너짐.

det.analysis:
주어 a few eccentrics(일부 괴짜들) + 조동사 might(~일지도 모른다) + 부사 deliberately(의도적으로) + 동사 cultivate(키우다) + 목적어 personal idiosyncracies(개인적 특이성) + 목적 표현 in order to attract attention(관심을 끌기 위해).

단어 순서: a → few → eccentrics → might → deliberately → cultivate → personal → idiosyncracies → in → order → to → attract → attention (13단어). 'in order to + 동사원형'은 '~하기 위해'.
det.tip: in order to + 동사원형 = ~하기 위해. might + 동사원형 = ~일지도 모른다. attract attention = 관심을 끌다.

questions.wa: a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention
accept: a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention

questions.passage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. __________. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)
우리말: 우리는 눈에 띄고 신뢰받는 존재가 되고 싶어 한다.
[조건] (1) and, be, believed, in, to, visible, want, We를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: We want to be(우리는 ~되고 싶어 한다) visible and believed in(눈에 띄고 신뢰받는 존재)
det.analysis:
주어 We + want to be(~이 되고 싶어 하다) + 보어 visible(보이는) and believed in(신뢰받는). visible(형용사)과 believed in(수동 과거분사)이 and로 병렬된다. believe in의 수동형이 'be believed in'.

단어 순서: We → want → to → be → visible → and → believed → in (8단어).
det.tip: want to be + 보어 = ~이 되고 싶다. visible(형용사)과 believed in(수동) 병렬. believe in → be believed in(신뢰받다).

questions.wa: We want to be visible and believed in
accept: We want to be visible and believed in
